model_source.policy: Unmodified state and questions sent as one /v1/systemone request; explicit capacity rejections (HTTP 422 with a known marker) are unsupported, other failures are errors.
model_source.translation: noul questions with empty criteria sent without the criteria key; array state sent as JSON text; 4xx naming the context limit recorded as unsupported; 429 retried with backoff; nothing else changed

latency: HTTP request wall time against the configured /v1/systemone endpoint, including server-side prompt construction and inference; excludes server startup.
